explanation: Store client credits relative to a common offset. AddAll changes only that offset; insertion replaces a normalized value. Scan the current clients to answer Max without an external tree package. The reset-aware operation adapter constructs a fresh ClientsCreditsInfo for each constructor operation, clearing both stored clients and the offset.
timeComplexity: Insert/Remove/Lookup: O(1) expected; AddAll: O(1); Max: O(n)
spaceComplexity: O(p) retained dictionary storage for peak clients during this instance
attribution: Original Python implementation and reset-aware operation adapter independently authored for EPI Practice from its displayed contract and independently authored C# solution; no upstream reference source adapted.
